title: Design System: Research and Engineering — Process

headline.purpose: Index, About and Resume titles; detail pages use a smaller clamp.

body.purpose: Long prose at a maximum of 70ch; --process-reading-size is 1.0625rem with 1.8 line height.

body-compact.purpose: At 600px and below, article prose uses --process-reading-compact (1rem) and 1.75 line height, giving 16px/28px at the default root size.

action.purpose: --process-action-size (.875rem) for Details/Code and tabular result counts; action links retain 44px minimum height.

motion.name: selection-glide
motion.purpose: Bounded selection-surface continuity; immediate with reduced motion.

motion.name: pixel-sweep
motion.purpose: Six-row aspect-fitted deterministic pixel arrival on hover and focus.

motion.name: subpage-paint-minimum
motion.purpose: Approximately 20fps discovery backdrop cadence; reading/Resume have no idle loop.

motion.name: control-feedback
motion.purpose: Shared borderless control color/surface feedback; reduced motion removes timing.

motion.name: foundation-node
motion.purpose: Foundation node gray-blue to navy; icons stay stationary.

motion.name: utility-depth-scroll
motion.purpose: Original cached 1100px process-train tile scrolls at 0.32 times page offset, at .27 opacity or .20 below 600px. Cached process/recycle routes share the existing canvas clock. Reduced motion uses normal page-relative scroll with no packets; reading masks remain active.

motion.name: affiliation-orbit
motion.purpose: CSS orbit at 78px radius with equal counter-rotation keeps brand geometry upright. Hover/focus-within pauses all five nodes; reduced motion and print are static. No JavaScript loop.

components.name: Career foundation link
components.description: Borderless 8px ghost About link with DitherSweep, inner grid label and gray-blue to navy path node. Icons remain stationary; dotted keyboard focus and static reduced-motion states follow shared process-controls.css. The self-contained preview uses the source default 12-column grid; production fits columns to link size.

narrative.northStar: Engineering paper and a connected process
narrative.overview: The approved process design is the main website at /. The /plant alias permanently redirects home. Warm paper, navy, pixel headings and measured process circuits unify discovery and reading surfaces; the established knowledge graph remains intact.
keyCharacteristics: Full-contrast reading copy with measured texture clearance
Quieter circuits on reading and Resume pages
Original connected feed/pump/exchanger/reactor/separator depth train with slower scroll and independent reading masks
Icon-only affiliation cloud in Background, using upright official SVG geometry with existing ghost links and pixel sweeps

rules.name: Reading clearance
rules.body: Clear grid texture beneath measured content and fade it back over 28 units.

rules.name: Motion follows the surface
rules.body: Discovery pages use bounded idle stipple and packets. Detail, experience and Resume backdrops repaint only on invalidation; reduced motion freezes decorative time.

rules.name: Shared ghost controls
rules.body: Use borderless 8px controls with 44px minimum height, visible pixel sweeps and 2px dotted keyboard focus. Keep labels and icons stationary.

rules.name: Affiliation marks
rules.body: Place the 230×250px cloud beside the Background career list, above it at <=900px. Five 60×60px links use a 78px orbit radius. Local navy alpha masks show Arclin symbol, Wood W letterform crop, intact Bayer cross, Alcon A letterform crop and Georgia Tech monogram. No full wordmarks/taglines or claims that Wood/Alcon crops are official standalone symbols. Preserve real destinations, accessible names, existing DitherSweep/dotted focus and both background reading masks. The 65s CSS orbit stays upright, pauses all nodes on hover/focus-within and is static for reduced motion/print.

rules.name: Connected depth train
rules.body: The original 1100px cached tile connects feed tank, pump, four-port exchanger, stirred reactor, tray separator and product trunk at boundary nozzles; recycle, shared utilities and instruments belong to the same train. Process pipes stay continuous and Bayer stipple stays inside equipment. Cache process/recycle flow routes and reuse the existing canvas loop.

dos: Keep canonical reading routes and the original graph.
Preserve full-color portrait and project assets.
Keep labels sharp and interactive targets at least 44px.
Publish portrait wave frames from the active process canvas.
donts: Do not restore the retired classic homepage or ambient wave without a request.
Do not imply the diagram is an operating facility.
Do not invent factual achievements, publications or equipment data.
Do not add remote fonts or gratuitous animation loops.
